name: Yatoon Appointment Booking for Salons & Spas
author: yatoon

sections.description:
Yatoon Appointment Booking for Salons & Spas is a lightweight, mobile-friendly appointment booking plugin built specifically for salons, spas, nail studios, and beauty businesses.

Core Features (Free)

  • Multi-step booking flow with real-time availability
  • Automatic booking confirmation email sent to customers
  • Appointment reminder emails — configurable hours before appointment
  • Unlimited services with flexible pricing and duration
  • Up to 2 staff members with individual schedules
  • Customer self-service portal — view, reschedule, or cancel appointments
  • Waitlist recovery and “Text Us” fallback when no slots are available
  • Cancellation & no-show policy display
  • Admin customer history and appointment management
  • Service menu shortcode — display your services like a restaurant menu

Upgrade to Pro

Pro unlocks Square & Vagaro calendar sync, SMS reminders, Google Calendar integration, unlimited staff, branding controls, and priority support.

Shortcodes

  • [yatoon_booking] — booking form
  • [yatoon_customer_portal] — customer appointment portal
  • [yatoon_manage_booking] — secure manage-booking page
  • [yatoon_service_menu] — public service menu
sections.changelog:
2.0.3

  • Fixed: Staff dropdown removed from Review & Book step to prevent booking failures caused by switching staff without re-validating time slot availability.

2.0.2

  • Improved: Booking confirmation email now includes all booked services when multiple services are selected in a single booking.
  • Improved: Admin bookings list now shows multi-service bookings clearly.

2.0.1

  • Improved: Step progress bar now animates and shows green checkmarks on completed steps.
  • Improved: Service cards now show image thumbnail and Popular badge prominently.
  • Improved: Success page redesigned — Google Calendar + Apple/Outlook (.ics) buttons, rebooking nudge.
  • Improved: Booking form text changed from “Book” to “ADD” to match expected UI.

2.0.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
  • Multi-step booking flow, customer portal, waitlist recovery, service menu, and admin dashboard included.
